title: The Bull Case For Hut 8 (HUT) Could Change Following Anthropic’s US$7B AI Data Center Deal
text: Earlier this month, Anthropic announced a long-term, up to 15-year, US$7.00 billion data center capacity agreement with Hut 8’s River Bend campus, alongside Hut 8’s continued build-out of multi-gigawatt infrastructure and backup “bring your own generation” power options. This partnership marks a major shift for Hut 8 toward long-duration, AI-focused infrastructure leasing that could reshape how its power and data assets are utilized beyond Bitcoin mining.
